subtitle: Quote, book and track parcels
release_notes: Initial release: check parcel delivery coverage, request quotes, book deliveries and track delivery progress through a connected RentADriver account.

purchasing.description: RentADriver arranges physical parcel pickup and delivery by couriers. Users obtain a delivery quote and pay for a physical delivery from their prepaid RentADriver wallet. The card-deposit tool links to Stripe Checkout for wallet funding; the user completes payment outside ChatGPT. The plugin does not sell digital content, software subscriptions or subscription upgrades.

reviewer_access.instructions: On the RentADriver OAuth consent page choose Allow with a sandbox account. No password, MFA, SMS or email code is required. Reconnect through the same option when access expires.

verification.transient_read_errors: Coverage and workspace-list calls passed on sequential retry.
